policy_note: Byte-budget guard for flesh-pits/var/ scratch growth. Measured baseline 2026-10-07: var/ = 153209107 bytes (scratch-mneumora-main frozen reference checkout = 153207599). The reference checkout must not grow. models/** holds pinned SHA-verified model artifacts (not scratch): no per-file cap, 2 GiB subtree cap. maxTotalBytes covers scratch + models envelope; growth beyond the documented envelope still fires. Exemption added 2026-10-07 (coordinator) for the 1.5B model-independence rung.
